title: NWP Product Lines
description: Seed rows for the product_line table. line_rank orders lines within one vendor and one category (1 = entry tier, higher = more capable). The High-Performance plan picks its SKU from the next line up from the Cost-Efficient pick. JSON Schema cannot express uniqueness, so the seed script and the table's UNIQUE constraints enforce: (vendor_id, category, name) is unique and (vendor_id, category, line_rank) is unique.

category.description: Same values as the device JSON's category field. Only categories the High-Performance rule applies to.

source_note.description: Basis for this line's rank, so the ladder can be defended and cited.
